-- a query
WITH recent AS (
  SELECT u.id, u.name, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY u.team_id) AS n
  FROM users u
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.user_id = u.id AND o.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days'
  WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
)
SELECT r.id, r.name, COALESCE(r.n, 0) AS n,
       CASE WHEN r.n > 1 THEN 'many' ELSE 'one' END AS kind
FROM recent r
ORDER BY n DESC, r.name
LIMIT 10;

INSERT INTO log (msg) VALUES ('ok') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, v JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');
